newsitem.title: USA: Miami police seize guns for Colombia in computers.
newsitem.headline: Miami police seize guns for Colombia in computers.

text.p: Customs agents in Miami seized a cache of dozens of semi-automatic rifles that had been dismantled and hidden inside desktop computers for shipping to Colombia, the U.S. Customs Service said on Friday.
A Colombian man, Juan Rodriguez, and his Spanish wife Ana were arrested and charged with violating arms export laws.
The pair, under surveillance by customs agents, are alleged to have bought 53 AR-15 semi-automatic rifles at a Miami gunshop. The gun is the civilian version of the U.S. Army's M-16.

They dismantled the rifles, obliterated the serial numbers so they could not be traced, a Customs Service statement said. They then removed the insides of desktop computers and put the gun parts inside.
They were arrested after taking the computers to a freight forwarder for shipment to Colombia last Friday.
